name: testing-best-practices
title_zh: 先问这条测试值不值，再谈怎么写
tagline_zh: 写完一堆测试覆盖率还是虚的？它先逼你说清这条测试防的是哪个真实故障，再决定断言、命名和测试数据。
tagline_en: Coverage looks fine but nothing feels safe? It makes you name the real failure each test guards, then picks.
desc_en: Laravel test design and review. Use when selecting coverage, naming or structuring tests, choosing assertions or test data, isolating dependencies, testing HTTP or security boundaries, improving suite performance, or reviewing test value. Use framework guidance or search-docs for Pest and PHPUnit syntax.
why_zh: 把测试当设计问题而非语法问题：先判价值，再选断言与隔离方式，语法交给官方文档。
why_en: Treats tests as a design problem, not a syntax one: judge value first, then assertions and isolation; leave syntax to the docs.
limit_zh: 只做设计与评审，不生成可运行代码，也不查 Pest/PHPUnit 语法——那要另开 search-docs。
limit_en: Design and review only: no runnable code generated, no Pest/PHPUnit syntax help (use search-docs). Laravel-scoped; standalone PHP libraries are out.
title_en: Asks if a test is worth writing before how
